The '''2015–16 Tahiti Ligue 1''' is the 69th season of top-flight [[Association football|football]] in [[Tahiti]].<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tahiti2016.html French Polynesia 2015/16], RSSSF.com</ref> [[A.S. Tefana|Tefana]] are the defending champions having won their fourth title last season.

{{Location map~ |Tahiti |lat=-17.845825 |long=-149.265154 |label=[[A.S. Taiarapu F.C.|Taiarapu]]}}

A total of eight sides will compete in the 2015–16 campaign. The top side will qualify for a place in the [[2017 OFC Champions League]], while the bottom two will be relegated to [[Tahiti Ligue 2]].
